Why Partner With Bothbest

Built for Importers, Distributors & Projects

Located in Anji—China’s Moso bamboo heartland—we control every step from raw stalk selection and kiln drying to CNC profiling and strict VOC inspection.

Complete Indoor-to-Outdoor Supply

Solid, strand woven, engineered click flooring, thermo-treated outdoor decking, veneer, countertops, and custom architectural panels.

Rapidly Renewable & Low-VOC Certified

Moso bamboo matures in 4–6 years versus 25+ years for hardwood. All collections meet strict European CE and environmental safety benchmarks.

Factory-Direct Pricing & OEM Flexibility

Cut out middlemen with transparent wholesale quotes, custom colors, private-label packaging, and reliable global shipping schedules.
